sources.snippet: You can now configure and run Evals directly in the OpenAI Dashboard. sources.title: GitHub - SalesforceAIResearch/gift-eval
sources.snippet: GIFT-Eval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate general time series forecasting models across diverse datasets, promoting the advancement of zero-shot forecasting capabilities in foundation models. To facilitate the effective pretraining and evaluation of foundation models, we also provide a non-leaking pretraining dataset --> GiftEvalPretrain.
